thread:
aisha: Hi all, confidential ask. I observe daily prayers that require two short breaks ~10m each around 1:15pm and 6:15pm. My calendar currently overlaps with team syncs and a standing weekly customer review. Can we set up a temporary accommodation so I can step out for these prayers without it affecting my performance review?

omar (Manager): Thanks for flagging, @aisha. We should be able to accommodate this. Can you confirm whether you want recurring calendar exceptions (blocked private time) or prefer informal check-outs? Also let me know which meetings conflict.

aisha: Prefer recurring private blocks (not visible to wider team). For meetings: 12:30pm team sync sometimes runs long and the Tues 6pm customer review conflicts with the evening prayer. I can shift prep earlier or join late where appropriate.

lucas (People Ops): We support religious accommodations like this. Process: 1) we can log a confidential accommodation entry; 2) PMs/managers can add private calendar blocks marked "personal" so others see busy but not details; 3) if coverage is needed for customer-facing slots, we can arrange swaps for those meetings. Accommodation won't be shared beyond HR/manager unless you request.

aisha: Thanks. Id like the private blocks and a one-off swap for the Tues 6pm customer review for the next quarter (3 months) while we see how it goes. Also want confirmation that this won't count against me in the quarterly performance calibration.

omar (Manager): Confirmed: I'll cover the Tue 6pm review for the quarter and assign someone else to handle live notes. For team syncs, please add the private blocks and I'll remind the team to keep syncs to 25m. We can also async the last 5 minutes via notes.

lucas (People Ops): Officially: temporary religious accommodation logged (private prayer breaks + meeting swap). Accommodation period: start 2256789012, review at 30 days, planned end 3 months (2259225012). We will notate this in a confidential HR case file. This will not negatively affect performance calibrations; your manager can include a private context note for reviewers if helpful.

aisha: Appreciate it. Quick logistics Q: will adding private blocks trigger any alerts or calendar automations? I want to avoid extra messages to the team.

lucas (People Ops): Good question. Use "Busy" blocks on your primary calendar with the visibility set to "Private." That shows as busy without details. People Ops can also add the blocks on your behalf and keep them private. No automated escalations will occur.

hr_bot: Action logged: accommodation-created by lucas for aisha (type: religious-schedule, start: 2256789012, next-review: 2256792612, planned-end: 2259225012). Notifications delivered to HR and manager only.

aisha: Thank you both. I feel more comfortable knowing this is documented and confidential. Ill DM any needed meeting lists for swaps.

omar (Manager): Sending a quick note to the hiring calendar and sync owner to tighten the timebox. Ping me if anything slips. :thumbsup:

lucas (People Ops): Follow-up: once you DM the meeting list, People Ops will either add private blocks or coordinate swaps with meeting owners. We can also add a one-line private manager note for the review packet.

aisha: DM sent. Closing loop for now — will report back after the first week if any adjustments needed.
